sections.title: Clear: take biggest split
sections.subtitle: Take the split away from green room
lines: As Bers you have the best clear potential that is not part of the bloodrush.
It is imperative that you take the biggest split off the spawn room.
Take the split away from green room.
M7 is a 6x6 map, so green can never spawn in the center.
If green is on the bottom of the map it will be on the bottom left or right side. Turn towards the opposite side, as that is where more undiscovered tiles are.
That is a rule of thumb. On some maps it will be different.
When you finish clearing to a dead-end secret, go backwards until you reach a room that is not a dead-end.
Midclear once all puzzles are opened.

sections.title: Maxor: right crystal
sections.subtitle: Place crystal 1, then 2, dig down to storm
lines: Berserker is the right crystal in the maxor phase.
When the boss starts, swap to your spring boots.
Pick up the crystal and wait on the pad to instantly place it.
Then grab the 2nd crystal and place it.
Dig down into storm so your teammates can leap to you.

sections.title: Storm: clear withers
sections.subtitle: Clear withers, then dig into terminals
lines: After dropping off your teammates at the purple red side, run over to green and yellow.
Clear the withers, focusing on the archers up on the pillars, then the sides, and clear mid last.
Stand under the lightning at green.
Then run to the coal and dig into the terminals phase.
Wait for the healer to leap to you.

sections.title: S1: i4 and leap
sections.subtitle: Pre-lb Goldor, do i4, leap tank then mage
lines: Bers's role in terms is: i4 / 53 / 3 dev / 3 bl.
When the healer leaps to you, dig into S4 as shown and make your way to the 4th device.
Pre-lb Goldor before beginning i4.
After completing i4, leap to the tank and swap masks.
Last breath Goldor if you missed before i4.
Then leap to the mage when ss finishes.

sections.title: S2: dev 5 and 3
sections.subtitle: Bonzo 2nd dev to 5, do 5 then 3
lines: Bonzo from 2nd dev to 5.
Open 5 while dropping off the edge so you are closer to 3.
Complete 5, then walk to the right and do 3.
Then leap to your healer who will be at ee3.
You should have 1 mask so you will not die to preleaping.
The safe spot is also right at 3 and you should wait there.

sections.title: S3: 3rd device
sections.subtitle: Bonzo off quartz to 3rd dev, leap mage
lines: Move to 3 if you didn't premove.
Bonzo from 3 off the quartz to go to the 3rd dev.
Once either you complete it OR the healer completes it, leap to the mage for core.

sections.title: S4: term then levers
sections.subtitle: Run to term, bonzo to levers, leap mage
lines: Run to your term as fast as possible.
Bonzo over to the levers after completing it.
Once the levers are done, leap again to the mage to get back into core.

sections.title: Goldor: run out and fire
sections.subtitle: Run out fast and fire ASAP
lines: When the Goldor phase starts, run out as fast as possible.
Try to fire as soon as possible.

sections.title: Necron: fire after he moves
sections.subtitle: Last breath after Necron moves sideways
lines: Leap to the mage when you drop and stand with them.
Get out your last breath and wait with it fully charged for necron to move either left or right.
Fire after he moves laterally to boost your arch and mages dps as soon as possible.
After you lb you can swap to your term and help dps.
Continue to dps necron when he is at middle as you will now be at full stacks.
You will be around ~25-30% of your teams total dmg.

sections.title: Relics: premove and flick
sections.subtitle: Premove, flick 180 on spawn, place relic
lines: Swap to racing helmet (Or 4/4 young dragon armor) with your black cat to get 650 speed.
Begin holding S and spamming right click with .2 left to spawn on your relic to hit a successful premove.
Flick 180 degrees when you see the relic spawn and place it in the cauldron.
You need to be fast for a fast purple relic.
Alternative method (easier): swap to black cat and a cow hat, and spam click.
Hold s, then flick and hold w when you see the relic spawn.

sections.title: Dragons: buff and stack
sections.subtitle: Run to stack spot at ~1000 ms left
lines: Stand middle after placing your relic.
Swap in your rogue sword, tuba, rag, and sword of bad health.
Use your rag axe on the wither kings 2nd dialogue ("I no longer wish to fight, but I know that will not stop you").
Use the rest of your buffs on yourself when you see the dragon title.
Rod to your ender dragon, and run to the stack spot for your split dragon.
Start running towards the dragon at around 1000 ms left to spawn.
Use your rag axe again as it comes off cooldown and go to the stack spot for dragon 3.
For non split dragons begin running at 1000-1200 ms (the higher the power the closer to 1200).
This is to "fast stack", which is better dps for a short burst but worse over a course of 2 seconds.
